name: io.github.udah1/hilan-mcp
description: Pull Hilan (Hilanet / חילן, חילנט) payslips and Form 106 into any AI assistant.

environmentVariables.description: Default tenant as a full URL, e.g. "https://amdocs.net.hilan.co.il" (optional if you always pass a `tenant` argument to tools instead). Takes priority over COMPANY_TENANT/COMPANY_CODE.
environmentVariables.name: COMPANY_URL

environmentVariables.description: Default tenant subdomain, e.g. "amdocs" (optional if COMPANY_URL is set or a `tenant` argument is always passed to tools).
environmentVariables.name: COMPANY_TENANT

environmentVariables.description: Default tenant as a numeric org code, e.g. "5227" (optional, lowest priority of the three tenant env vars).
environmentVariables.name: COMPANY_CODE

environmentVariables.description: Database encryption key (only needed if you skip `npx hilan-mcp setup-key`, which stores it in your OS credential store instead).
environmentVariables.name: HILAN_DB_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Path to a CA bundle, only needed on a network with a TLS-intercepting corporate proxy (e.g. "self-signed certificate in certificate chain" errors).
environmentVariables.name: NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS
